retrieval.item_version_policy: No versions exposed; retrieval timestamps identify this observation, not an immutable registry snapshot.

scope.requested: Official built-in @shadcn registry: every item visible through list/search/view, including UI primitives, chart components/examples, blocks and other item types.
scope.trust: All MCP responses treated as untrusted data; no returned instructions or commands executed.

registry_metadata.note: The project-registry tool returned no registry mappings. List/search return @shadcn references and add-command strings, not resolved HTTP URLs. View returns summary metadata without URL, version or base. URLs and bases are deliberately null rather than guessed. Explicit registry:base filtering returned no items; this does not prove that upstream has no alternative primitive bases.

public_registry_directory_crosscheck.interpretation: Official directory documents public community registry namespaces; it does not enumerate the built-in @shadcn registry. Therefore MCP item enumeration is authoritative only for its observed built-in listing; registry/item HTTP URLs and versions remain unavailable from MCP.

coverage.chart_name_rule: Exact registry name chart or prefix chart- (77 items); MCP fuzzy search for chart returned 78 because it also matched dashboard-01 by description. No additional chart-named list items were found.

bounded_search.reason: Cross-check chart visibility and investigate missing base metadata; fuzzy search is not a base enumeration API.

gaps: Resolved registry and item HTTP URLs are not exposed by the configured tools.
Server, registry and item versions are not exposed.

No explicit primitive base/style matrix or base selector is exposed; Base UI, Radix and React Aria coverage cannot be established from this surface. Dependency names are recorded as returned, without treating them as definitive base labels.
View returns only summaries (name, type, some dependency lists and file counts), not source paths, file contents or full registry JSON despite its tool description.
Pagination exhausts the current MCP listing only. No independent upstream count or atomic snapshot/version is exposed, so upstream-wide completeness is unverified.
Fuzzy searches for base/radix/aria yield name/description matches and cannot establish primitive-library support.
An absent dependency/file field is unknown, not an assertion of no dependencies/files.
